_about: Master record for the job search, in the ai-era-job-kit format. Public-safe: resume, LinkedIn and GitHub are generated from this file and the curated entries in brag/entries. Caveats, open questions and the do-not-claim list live in ../archive/guardrails.md, which is private.

profile.name: Daniel J. Wirz
profile.headline: Senior software engineer who makes other people's systems work with yours: healthcare integrations, payments and legacy modernization
profile.summary: I make other people's systems work with yours, in places where mistakes cost money or care. At Propeller Health I connected a Class II medical-device platform to Walgreens and Express Scripts and helped make its provider portal work inside Epic; at HYP I was one of two founding engineers on a real-time auction platform where no bid counted until a Stripe hold guaranteed it; at Kyros I automated monthly insurance eligibility checks for 1,000–2,000 patients. I work across backend, frontend, data and AWS, and I'm usually the engineer translating between partners, founders or operations staff and the code.
profile.availability: Full time, open to contract. Can start any time. Ideally remote, willing to discuss.

artifacts.name: Holdfast
artifacts.one_liner: Real-time auctions where a bid counts only once a Stripe test-mode hold covers it
evidence: Load test of near-simultaneous bids with an invariant checker
CI with unit, integration and Playwright tests

artifacts.name: Token Keeper
artifacts.one_liner: Keeps third-party account connections alive: OAuth tokens refreshed and re-verified on a schedule, state reported through one signed webhook
evidence: Concurrency test of the refresh lease
Alarm drills fired live against the deployed stack

artifacts.name: Crapless
artifacts.one_liner: A crapless craps table for friends: join by link on a phone, take a seat, pass the dice; play money only
evidence: House edge of every bet checked against textbook values
Server and two-phone browser tests in CI

artifacts.name: bid-storm
artifacts.one_liner: A Go load generator that records every stage of a storm of auction bids against a local Holdfast, then checks the recording; a live page shows a recorded storm and sweeps
evidence: Checks over a published recording, each with what it can't show
CI storms a pinned Holdfast and requires a broken copy to fail

in_flight.name: FHIR over MCP
in_flight.one_liner: A read-only, patient-scoped MCP server over synthetic FHIR data, with an eval suite that checks every claim; its patients come from the shared synthetic-cohort package

in_flight.name: Coverage Check
in_flight.one_liner: Bulk insurance eligibility checks against an unreliable, rate-limited payer, with FHIR output, on Kubernetes; its members come from the shared synthetic-cohort package
evidence: Correct under chaos on a local Kubernetes cluster while pods are killed

in_flight.name: synthetic-cohort
in_flight.one_liner: One byte-reproducible set of synthetic Synthea patients and made-up insurance coverage, for FHIR over MCP and Coverage Check to share

in_flight.name: holdfast-ex
in_flight.one_liner: Holdfast's problem solved again in Elixir/OTP: one process per auction, an append-only event log, holds derived from state

backs.label: Stripe holds and real-time bidding, told a second way

evidence: Property tests of the pure core
Holdfast's page and storm run against it, with payments still a stand-in

in_flight.name: Respiratory view
in_flight.one_liner: A SMART on FHIR app showing asthma and COPD patients' controller and rescue medication use, with an AI summary measured by evals

_artifacts_note: Live public projects (deployed, depth 2 or more) go in artifacts. Projects still being built or planned go in in_flight, which the kit's scripts ignore, so planned work never counts as proof (portfolio repo ADR 0006). Employer stories live in case-studies/ and are not artifacts.

McCaslin of the poster "Exploitation of Variable Pathlength Spectroscopy for the Spectroscopic Characterization and Quantitation of Proteins and Peptides".

research.group: Biophysics Instrumentation Facility, Department of Biochemistry

publications.title: Exploitation of Variable Pathlength Spectroscopy for the Spectroscopic Characterization and Quantitation of Proteins and Peptides
publications.summary: Used the C Technologies SoloVPE on a Cary 50 to quantitate proteins from the slope of absorbance against pathlength, removing serial dilutions, and to measure the full extinction spectrum of bovine serum albumin; results agreed with a Cary 400 in under an hour versus several hours.

brag._note: One curated entry file per role, named for the role's end date (the current role uses the date it was written). Each file is a pool of single accomplishments; experience[].highlights is the default selection, and a tailored resume picks a different set per job description. Unconfirmed claims wait in brag/inbox until confirmed or dropped.
